My dear [C C](../persons.html#329)
By all means-
My people sail on the 26th I think [Mrs Woollcombe ](../persons.html#1558)stays till Novr 1 and [Lottie](../persons.html#1588) does not come till the end of the month [Mary Morshead](../persons.html#28) comes to do her African lectures on Mondays She has just given her first and you will come in for the two last-
I had a very interesting East London parson to entertain on Sunday week, a Huguenot who had been everywhere- I mean an old Huguenot family of course.

Xtian knowledge deals in historical stories Leila’s Quest is good also ‘Brownie’- the last not [SPCK](../others.html#40)
your affte

C M Yonge
